name: 大功率多功能木工修边机款
description: 多刀型一机搞定、结构逐点标注、铜芯动力图解、参数透明可查

styleLock.backgroundSystem: alternating clean panel-white #F7F7F8 infographic sections and deep charcoal #17181A dramatic sections, with grey gradient studio backdrop for hero and marble-white textured panel for selling-point grids
styleLock.lightingSystem: neutral studio light at 5600K; bright even high-key with soft contact shadow on light panels, dramatic directional key with controlled falloff and cool rim on charcoal sections
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte light-stone plinth, brushed aluminium body language, clear acrylic base, raw and finished light wood workpieces
styleLock.typography: bold modern geometric sans-serif headlines; charcoal #2D2D2D on light panels, white on charcoal sections
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line black icons with red #D6302E accents, red rounded pill sub-labels, red annotation dots with thin leader lines, red glowing focus rings
styleLock.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero angle and consistent product scale; product always grounded with a soft contact shadow; annotations use small round red dots with thin leader lines that never cross the product silhouette
styleLock.lockText: consistent industrial woodworking power-tool ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of panel white #F7F7F8, deep charcoal #17181A, brushed aluminium silver #C9CCD0 and one signal-red accent #D6302E; neutral studio lighting at 5600K, bright and even on light panels, dramatic directional key with controlled falloff on charcoal sections; bold modern geometric sans-serif headlines in charcoal #2D2D2D on light panels and white on charcoal sections; consistent red rounded pill labels, thin-line black icons with red accents, red annotation dots with thin leader lines and red glowing focus rings; clean product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable slight 3/4 hero angle and consistent product scale; clean balanced framing with soft contact shadow always present; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 搜索列表里一眼看清完整机身，赢取点击并满足平台主图规范
shots.camera: straight-on slight 3/4 front view, eye-level, full product upright and unclipped
shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio light, soft front-left key with fill card, single soft contact shadow
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Centered slight 3/4 front view at eye-level, full product upright on its clear base and fully visible, never clipped by the frame. Bright even high-key studio lighting, soft front-left key with fill, one soft contact shadow grounding the base. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF. Product occupies 60-70% of the frame, centered with even margins around the silhouette so the full body reads at thumbnail size. Marketplace main-image compliant, completely text-free. 2K, commercial e-commerce quality. Negative: no props, no hands, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra text, no decorative elements, no gradient background, no cut-off edges, no floating product without contact shadow.

shots.intent: 用石台展台与灰渐变摄影棚气势承接首屏，左侧文案区一秒传递核心卖点
shots.camera: slight 3/4 front view, eye-level, product standing on a plinth in the right half
shots.lighting: bright diffused 5600K studio light, gentle top-left key, soft contact shadow on the plinth
shots.background: grey gradient studio backdrop from #F4F4F6 to #DBDBDE, matte light-stone plinth #D6D6D9
shots.props: single blurred monstera leaf accent at a frame edge, muted green #3E5F45 tones
shots.textZone: left 40% clean vertical copy column: headline plus three small pill labels
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce benefit hero of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Product stands on a matte light-stone plinth filling the right 55-60% of a vertical frame at a slight 3/4 front angle, eye-level. Bright diffused 5600K studio light with a gentle top-left key and a soft contact shadow under the base. Grey gradient studio backdrop #F4F4F6 to #DBDBDE, plinth #D6D6D9, one blurred monstera leaf accent allowed at a frame edge. The left 40% is a clean copy column with a bold headline in #2D2D2D reading 「{callout_1}」 and three small grey pill labels stacked below with comfortable spacing, reading 「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」「{callout_4}」. 2K. Negative: no dense body text, no watermark, no fake logo, no hands, no cluttered props, no cut-off product, no invented claims.

shots.intent: 放大手工修边毛刺刮手的熟悉痛点，用同一木料的两种状态引出产品价值
shots.camera: macro documentary close-up with a slightly handheld feel, vertical split framing
shots.lighting: heavier directional low-key on the problem side, brighter cleaner light on the solution side
shots.background: split panel: raw splintered timber #EDEDED base with wood edge #B98A5A on the left, finished smooth edge on #F7F7F8 with wood tone #C89B6B on the right
shots.props: wood shavings and burr fragments scattered on the problem side
shots.textZone: bottom caption strip, at least 15% of frame height, with two short labels
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce pain-point split screen for {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Vertical split framing: the left half is a macro of a raw splintered wood edge with raised burrs, chipping and scattered shavings on a rough timber surface, lit with heavier directional low-key light; the right half shows the same wood edge finished smooth, square and clean under brighter, softer light, implying the result achieved with {product}. Wood tones #B98A5A raw and #C89B6B finished, panels #EDEDED and #F7F7F8. The wood texture fills about 40-50% of the frame with the split edge running through the middle. A bottom caption strip about 15% of frame height holds a short label 「{callout_1}」 on the left and 「{callout_2}」 on the right in #2D2D2D. 2K. Negative: no injury, no blood, no hands, no fabricated statistics, no dense body text, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 用六张图标卡汇总购买理由，快速巩固选择动机
shots.camera: flat orthographic infographic layout, no product photo
shots.lighting: even flat lighting, no cast shadows
shots.background: marble-white textured panel #FAFAFA with subtle grey veining #EFEFEF
shots.whitespace: about 15% panel margins around the card grid, cards separated by even gutters
shots.textZone: centered headline row above the grid, one short label inside each card
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce infographic of six selling-point cards for {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Flat symmetrical 2x3 card grid on a marble-white textured panel #FAFAFA with subtle grey veining #EFEFEF. A bold headline in #2D2D2D reading 「{callout_1}」 sits centered above the grid with a signal-red pill sub-label 「{selling_point_1}」 under it. Six rounded-corner cards filled #F2F2F3 with thin #E3E3E5 borders, each holding one thin-line black icon with a red accent and one short label 「{callout_2}」 through 「{callout_7}」 in #2D2D2D. No product photo inside the cards. The grid keeps about 15% panel margins on all sides with even gutters between cards. 2K. Negative: no product render inside cards, no dense body text, no certificate or award icons, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra English filler text.

shots.intent: 以十种刀路切口的木纹剖面图证明一机多用的加工能力
shots.camera: flat orthographic diagram grid, viewed straight from above, no product photo
shots.lighting: even flat rendering light, no cast shadows
shots.background: clean white #FFFFFF with one soft blurred workshop band #ECECEC behind the headline only
shots.whitespace: about 15% panel margins around the diagram grid, even gutters between blocks
shots.textZone: centered headline row above the grid, one short tag under each diagram block
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce infographic of ten cutting profiles achievable with {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. A bold headline in #2D2D2D reading 「{callout_1}」 with a signal-red pill sub-label 「{selling_point_1}」 on clean white #FFFFFF, and one soft blurred workshop band #ECECEC behind the headline only. Below, a two-row by five-column grid of wood-textured block diagrams, blocks in #C89B6B with grain lines #8A6238, each block cut into a different profile such as square groove, round-bottom groove, chamfer, flush trim, V-groove, rabbet, round-over, lock miter, dovetail and 45-degree bevel, each labeled with a short tag in the same style, eight of them reading 「{callout_2}」 through 「{callout_9}」 in #2D2D2D. Pure diagram panel, no product photo, the grid keeps about 15% panel margins with even gutters between blocks. 2K. Negative: no real product photo, no dense body text, no invented technical numbers, no watermark, no fake logo, no garbled labels.

shots.intent: 红点引线逐点解释开关、散热、碳刷、手柄与底座，消除结构疑虑
shots.camera: straight-on full front view, eye-level, product perfectly centered and upright
shots.lighting: bright even high-key, soft top-front key, minimal shadow
shots.textZone: seven short annotation labels alternating left and right with thin leader lines
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce annotated structure infographic of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Product perfectly centered, upright, straight-on full front view occupying 65-75% of the frame on clean #F7F7F8, with the annotation labels arranged in the side margins where the body narrows. Seven small red annotation dots with thin red leader lines point to key parts, alternating left and right and never crossing the product silhouette, each with a short label in #2D2D2D reading 「{callout_1}」 through 「{callout_7}」. Bright even high-key lighting with a soft top-front key and minimal contact shadow. 2K. Negative: no dense body text, no watermark, no fake logo, no leader lines crossing the product, no duplicated parts, no cut-off edges.

shots.intent: 黑底爆炸图展示铜绕组与转子结构，把动力卖点视觉化
shots.camera: dramatic low 3/4 angle of an exploded motor core floating diagonally
shots.lighting: dramatic directional key with controlled falloff, cool blue rim light on the shaft
shots.background: deep charcoal #17181A with faint smoke wisps and tiny spark particles
shots.props: faint smoke wisps and tiny spark particles only
shots.textZone: top headline row with thin slash separators
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce exploded-view mechanism infographic for {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. A floating exploded motor core rendered diagonally at a dramatic low 3/4 angle on deep charcoal #17181A with faint smoke wisps and tiny sparks: a copper-wound stator in #C97A3A with fine winding lines, a machined steel rotor shaft in #C9CCD0 with crisp highlights, and separated housing rings drifting apart. Two bold red arrows sweep in from the left as airflow and one glowing blue ring arrow wraps the shaft to suggest rotation. Dramatic directional key with controlled falloff plus a cool blue rim light. The core fills 60-70% of the frame, wrapped in deep charcoal tones that keep the visual focus on the copper and steel. A white headline row near the top reads 「{callout_1}」 with thin slash separators. 2K. Negative: no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo, no duplicated shafts, no impossible reflections, no garbled English filler.

shots.intent: 高角度微距对准夹头螺母配红圈焦点，证明夹持精准与做工细节
shots.camera: high 45-degree macro looking down the aluminium cylinder into the collet nut, shallow depth of field
shots.lighting: soft diffused 5600K with one controlled specular streak along the brushed aluminium
shots.background: clean panel white #F7F7F8 with the blurred clear base fading out in the far background
shots.whitespace: minimal, detail is the whole point
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of {product}, tight zoom on the hex collet nut at the front of the brushed aluminium motor can. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. High 45-degree angle looking down the silver cylinder into the black hex nut, detail occupies 55-60% with shallow depth of field and the foreground sharp. Soft diffused 5600K light with one controlled specular streak along the brushed aluminium #C9CCD0, and a glowing signal-red #D6302E light ring circling the collet nut as the focus accent. Blurred clear acrylic base fading into clean #F7F7F8. A short headline 「{callout_1}」 in #2D2D2D sits near the bottom. 2K. Negative: no blurry subject, no hands, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo, no duplicated cylinder shapes, no floating parts.

shots.intent: 左参数卡右整机尺寸线，一次性消除功率与尺寸的全部疑问
shots.camera: straight-on full front view beside a spec card, eye-level
shots.lighting: even flat readable light, soft contact shadow
shots.textZone: left spec card text block plus dimension unit labels on thin extension lines at the right
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce size spec screen of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Two-column layout on clean #F7F7F8: the left column is a spec card with a grey header bar #E4E4E6 holding 「{callout_1}」 and six to seven short spec rows 「{callout_2}」 through 「{callout_8}」 in #2D2D2D separated by thin #E3E3E5 rules; the right column shows the product upright in straight-on full front view occupying 60-70% of its column, wrapped by black dimension callout lines marking overall height, width and depth, each dimension carrying a short unit label in #2D2D2D on a thin extension line, for example 「{callout_9}」. Even flat readable lighting and a soft contact shadow. 2K. Negative: no dense paragraphs, no watermark, no fake logo, no unreadable tiny text, no missing units, no invented certification marks.

shots.textZone: text half of each stacked card: one red headline plus two or three short benefit lines

Two stacked horizontal rounded cards on #F7F7F8 with thin #E3E3E5 borders, each card split half text and half macro photo with sides alternating: first card photo left and text right, second card photo right and text left. The macro crops show tight detail of the housing surface finish, the textured rubber grip and the clear acrylic base edge, each crop filling 55-60% of its card. Bright even lighting with crisp, realistic material texture. 2K. Negative: no dense body text, no watermark, no fake logo, no over-smoothed plastic surfaces, no duplicated card layouts, no cut-off textures.

Deep charcoal #17181A stage with the product rising from the lower right at a low angle looking slightly upward, occupying 50-60%, lit by a dramatic directional key with a signal-red #D6302E edge glow and a soft contact shadow grounding the base. Large white headline 「{callout_1}」 in the upper left with a signal-red pill sub-label 「{selling_point_1}」 and a rounded signal-red #D6302E CTA button reading 「{callout_2}」 below it, the dark stage around them keeping all attention on the product and the button. 2K. provenance.notes: 9 张 800x1200 详情页切片提炼（相邻重叠 60px）。源图中的标题文案、英文乱文、具体参数（功率/电压/转速/净重/铣刀直径等）与右下角会员招募二维码贴纸均已剥离，参数改由 callout 文案槽位承载。图中主产品为红色铝体掌上型木工修边机（带透明亚克力底座），与源文件夹名一致。刀型名称为通用刀路术语，非源图原文。与库内电钻/冲击扳手模版通过 leaf slug 与修边开槽刀路语言区分。
